Lemo-Opuscar

 99 film styles for your coding agent. Pick one, bring your story, and the agent makes the film, entirely in code. 

 99 种影片风格，每种都配一支完全用代码做出来的短片 · 🇨🇳 中文用户请看 简体中文说明 

 ▶ Open the gallery · 中文画廊

 

 Official repo: github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar · by Lemomo (@lemomo ai) 

 

 [!IMPORTANT]
 This release was audited and improved with Claude Fable 5.2. 
 
 Built for Claude. Claude Fable, Opus and Sonnet all work; set effort to high (in Claude Code, type /effort high ). Other models may not reproduce the styles well, so use them with care.

 🆕 New

- 2026-11-12 · 33 new styles : 99 now, in 15 categories sorted by what the picture looks like, and the gallery in English and Chinese, with a page for every style. Some demo films remade, bugs fixed, style prompts improved. See the styles ↓
- 2026-10-22 · Make a style your own: change a style or start blank, and keep it. See how ↓

 How it works

1. Pick a style. Browse the gallery by what the picture looks like, or search for what you are making: explainers, launches, news, music videos.
2. Watch its demo. Every style has a short film made in code, and a page with stills, what it suits and the STYLE.md your agent follows.
3. Ask your agent. Install the skill once, then say it in one sentence:

 

Name the style in English or Chinese, or by its folder; the style index lists them all. Add a length, a narrator, your own photos or music if you like:

 Make a 45-second film in the watercolor style about the coffee farm my family runs. Warm female narrator.

 Make a 40-second LiDAR Survey film about the old quarry in the hills behind our town, from public laser-scan data.

 Install

 The skill (recommended). In your terminal:

 

Then use it from any folder. On first use it downloads the guides, tools and style prompts to /lemo-opuscar , shared by all your films; each film's project, from source to finished video, goes in the folder you started from. For other agents, copy plugin/skills/lemo-opuscar/ into their skills folder.

 Or clone the repo. Films go into films/ / inside it.

 

 Update or uninstall

Update, then restart Claude Code (the library in /lemo-opuscar updates itself on the next film):

 

To have it update by itself: in Claude Code, type /plugin , open Marketplaces , pick lemolab and choose Enable auto-update (third-party marketplaces such as lemolab don't update automatically until you turn this on).

From a clone: git pull , then run sh plugin/skills/lemo-opuscar/scripts/setup.sh deps once (it updates only the core packages that changed; if you installed the voice or music packages, run … deps voice music instead).

After an update, ask for a film as usual; to make a style your own, see below.

Uninstall, then delete /lemo-opuscar :

 

Your own styles in /lemo-my-styles/ stay through updates and uninstalls; delete that folder yourself if you don't want them. If a step stays stuck, open an issue.

 What happens next

Not sure yet? With the skill installed, type /lemo-opuscar:lemo-opuscar and nothing else. It asks which language to use, then what you'd like to do: a film in a library style, make a style your own, or a film in a style you've saved.

It asks you once, up front: anything it can't decide about your topic; whether you have your own voice, music or other material ; whether you want to see a storyboard first (say yes and it stops once to show you the key shots in the real style; otherwise it goes straight to the finished film).

Then the agent reads three guides and works like a small studio:

 File What it gives the agent 
 --- --- 
 DIRECTOR.md how to direct: story, sound, rhythm, camera, performance, self-checks 
 TECHNIQUE.md how to build: frame-by-frame rendering, voice, music, mixing 
 styles/ /STYLE.md what the style looks and sounds like; the story is yours 

Every film is directed, drawn, scored and mixed by the agent writing code: 🎨 canvas and WebGL pages rendered frame by frame, 🎵 original scores from free sample libraries, 🎙️ text-to-speech narration. No video generation, no stock footage.

 Before you start

- A film takes an agent about 30–60 minutes and a fair amount of tokens.
- You need Node 20+, ffmpeg 7+ and Python 3.11+ (or uv); the agent installs the rest. Ubuntu 24.04 ships ffmpeg 6.1, which is too old: use a static build.
- Three styles draw their characters with an image generator you bring (Manga Panels, Text Flash Cuts, Comic History Cartoon; marked ✦ in the style list): the Codex CLI signed in to an account that can generate images, or another image tool you have. Without one, those three can't start; every other style works without it.
- Default output 1920×1080 at 24 fps (some styles set their own frame rate, such as 30 fps); other sizes on request.

 Make a style your own

Your own brand colours, logo, characters, the tone of your channel: change a library style into one that's only yours, or make one from a blank page that the library doesn't have. It's the same process I use to add a new style to the library.

 
 A library style · Swiss Motion Graphics A flat grid, one signal colour, every move on the beat. 
 My style · Material Grid · ▶ 31 s demo film The Swiss grid, beat and type kept, the shapes made of clay, plastic, felt, glass and chrome: from above it reads as a poster, one tilt and it's a table of objects. 
 

Pick it after starting the skill, or say it in one line:

 I want to change the Ukiyo-e style into my own version.

 Start from a blank page: a chalk-on-blackboard style, warm and slow.

To change a library style, it lists every style with the gallery link and you type the one to change. From a blank page, describe the look in your own words, or share a picture or a film you like; Claude picks the closest library style as the technique base, tells you why, and you agree or pick another. install.title: Install
install.html:
The skill (recommended). In your terminal:

claude plugin marketplace add lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar
claude plugin install lemo-opuscar@lemolab

Then use it from any folder. On first use it downloads the guides, tools and style prompts to ~/lemo-opuscar, shared by all your films; each film's project, from source to finished video, goes in the folder you started from. For other agents, copy plugin/skills/lemo-opuscar/ into their skills folder.

Or clone the repo. Films go into films/<name>/ inside it.

git clone https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar.git
cd lemo-opuscar
claude
